batch_objective: Performance and scale (B-33 / S-15, S-18, S-19): measure first, then remedy. MAX_RENDER_NODES bounds the node COUNT, not the render WORK — a 73-node map was measured at 72.5 s because cost follows edges (the 51-node fixture carries 410); three private copies of the constant over three walks, and children_of is O(E) per call. Establish a reproducible measurement harness, then bound and reduce the work so large maps stay responsive. Behaviour-preserving except where a bound must change what is painted, and then only as the requirements state.
